title: Jupyter Connection File
description: A description of the data required to connect and send messages to a Jupyter Kernel

signature_scheme.description: scheme used to sign the messages

key.description: key used to sign the messages

ip.description: ip of the machine where the kernel runs

shell_port.description: port used by the shell channel

control_port.description: port used by the control channel

stdin_port.description: port used by the stdin channel

hb_port.description: port used by the heartbeat channel

iopub_port.description: port used by the iopub channel

encryption.description: CurveZMQ keys for transport encryption. The two keys appear together; without them the kernel channels are not encrypted.

curve_publickey.description: Z85-encoded 40-character ASCII string holding the server's CurveZMQ public key. Kernels must apply this to their ZMQ sockets before binding.

curve_secretkey.description: Z85-encoded 40-character ASCII string holding the server's CurveZMQ secret key. Kernels must apply this to their ZMQ sockets before binding.
